notes: This minor release adds five packs and a broader Python performance summary pack, and stays compatible with Bifrost 0.15.3 and later. It is built by the released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.3 (public commit f7e104a77b4f869f342dd73af0cc622c4a1a0584), the same producer as packs 0.16.0, because a 0.15.4-produced bundle panics Java analysis on released Bifrost 0.15.4 (bifrost-dev#15349). The release index stays schema 4. Added (#418): the reviewed bifrost.python-flask-request-declarations, bifrost.python-werkzeug-request-declarations, bifrost.python-werkzeug-request-summaries, bifrost.python-django-request-declarations and bifrost.python-django-request-summaries 0.1.0. Their shards activate only on pinned pkg:pypi/flask, werkzeug and django versions, and only on Bifrost 0.15.4 or later. Changed: bifrost.python-performance-summaries 1.2.0 (#168) declares json.loads, json.dumps and re.compile effects and the missing pickle.loads and pickle.dumps arities, so parsing-, serialization- and regex-compile-in-loop no longer stay inconclusive on those calls, and it carries input to the return value so taint is not cut through them. bifrost.python-stdlib-api-declarations is regenerated from its updated spec. The other 70 packs keep their IDs, versions and manifests. Qualification: all 319 open policy fixtures were run on released Bifrost 0.15.4 (macOS arm64) with packs 0.16.0 and with this bundle, and all 319 are identical. In a parallel first pass under heavy machine load, the eight Flask and Django request fixtures varied between failed (endpoint_role_unresolved), an engine panic and their normal result on both bundles; run one at a time, all eight match. Those fixtures keep their own copies of the new request packs and still report their findings. Source-only models are not in this native release, including the Python HTTP-client (requests, httpx, aiohttp, urllib3), Python untrusted-parsing, Node zlib and fs, web-network JavaScript and Rust core-logging packs. This release does not qualify every pack or imply complete analysis.
